instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Defense in depth and the five layers

questions.question: What is defense in depth?
options: A single very strong control at the network edge.
Replacing every control with an AI-driven detector.
Encrypting every layer with a different algorithm.
Layered controls at different levels so one failure is covered.
options_ar: ضابط واحد قوي جداً عند حافة الشبكة.
استبدال كل ضابط بكاشف مدفوع بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
ضوابط طبقية بمستويات مختلفة حتى يُغطّى أي فشل.
options_en: A single very strong control at the network edge.
Replacing every control with an AI-driven detector.
Encrypting every layer with a different algorithm.
Layered controls at different levels so one failure is covered.
questions.explanation: It is a layered approach ensuring controls exist at several levels, so that if one fails the others compensate.
questions.explanation_ar: هو نهج طبقي يضمن وجود ضوابط بعدة مستويات، بحيث لو فشل واحد يعوّضه غيره.

questions.question: Which five layers does the chapter identify?
options: Hardware, firmware, kernel, service and shell.
Ingress, egress, transit, internal and external.
Perimeter, detection, application, endpoint and user.
Physical, network, transport, session and presentation.
options_ar: العتاد والبرنامج الثابت والنواة والخدمة والصدفة.
المحيط والكشف والتطبيق والأجهزة الطرفية والمستخدم.
options_en: Hardware, firmware, kernel, service and shell.
Ingress, egress, transit, internal and external.
Perimeter, detection, application, endpoint and user.
Physical, network, transport, session and presentation.
questions.explanation: Those five are the levels at which the chapter expects controls to coexist: network, host, application and user.
questions.explanation_ar: هذي الخمسة هي المستويات اللي يتوقّع الفصل وجود ضوابط فيها معاً: الشبكة والمضيف والتطبيق والمستخدم.

questions.question: Which controls belong to the perimeter layer?
options: Policies, awareness and multi-factor authentication.
Firewalls, VPNs and proxies.
Antivirus and endpoint detection.
Secure coding and web application firewalls.
options_en: Policies, awareness and multi-factor authentication.
Firewalls, VPNs and proxies.
Antivirus and endpoint detection.
Secure coding and web application firewalls.
questions.explanation: The perimeter layer is where traffic first meets policy, which is why the three mediation technologies live there.
questions.explanation_ar: طبقة المحيط هي وين يلتقي الترافيك بالسياسة أول مرة، ولهذا تسكنها تقنيات التوسّط الثلاث.

questions.question: Which controls belong to the detection layer?
options: IDS/IPS and SIEM systems.
Firewalls and reverse proxies.
Antivirus and EDR agents.
Policies and awareness training.
options_en: IDS/IPS and SIEM systems.
Firewalls and reverse proxies.
Antivirus and EDR agents.
Policies and awareness training.
questions.explanation: Detection is its own layer because seeing an intrusion is a different job from blocking it at the edge.
questions.explanation_ar: الكشف طبقة بحد ذاتها لأن رؤية التسلل شغل مختلف عن حجبه عند الحافة.

questions.question: Which controls belong to the application layer?
options: Firewalls, VPNs and forward proxies.
Antivirus, EDR and disk encryption.
MFA, policies and user awareness.
Secure coding and web application firewalls.
options_ar: مكافح الفيروسات و EDR وتشفير الأقراص.
البرمجة الآمنة وجدران حماية تطبيقات الويب.
options_en: Firewalls, VPNs and forward proxies.
Antivirus, EDR and disk encryption.
MFA, policies and user awareness.
Secure coding and web application firewalls.
questions.explanation: This layer lives inside the software and at its front door, so it addresses flaws that no network control can see.
questions.explanation_ar: هذي الطبقة تعيش داخل البرمجية وعند بابها الأمامي، فتعالج عيوباً ما يقدر أي ضابط شبكي يشوفها.

questions.question: Which controls belong to the endpoint layer?
questions.question_ar: أي ضوابط تنتمي لطبقة الأجهزة الطرفية؟
options: Firewalls and TLS-terminating proxies.
Secure coding standards and code review.
Antivirus and endpoint detection and response.
IDS/IPS and SIEM correlation engines.
options_ar: الجدارات النارية والبروكسيات المنهية لـ TLS.
options_en: Firewalls and TLS-terminating proxies.
Secure coding standards and code review.
Antivirus and endpoint detection and response.
IDS/IPS and SIEM correlation engines.
questions.explanation: Endpoint controls are the last line that still has a chance to act on the device itself.
questions.explanation_ar: ضوابط الأجهزة الطرفية هي آخر خط لا يزال عنده فرصة يتصرّف على الجهاز نفسه.

questions.question: Which controls belong to the user layer?
options: Antivirus engines and EDR agents.
Policies, awareness and multi-factor auth.
Firewalls, VPNs and proxies at the edge.
IDS/IPS sensors and SIEM platforms.
options_ar: الجدارات والشبكات الخاصة والبروكسيات عند الحافة.
options_en: Antivirus engines and EDR agents.
Policies, awareness and multi-factor auth.
Firewalls, VPNs and proxies at the edge.
IDS/IPS sensors and SIEM platforms.
questions.explanation: The user layer is where a stolen password is either stopped by a second factor or accepted without one.
questions.explanation_ar: طبقة المستخدم هي وين كلمة مرور مسروقة إما تُوقف بعامل ثانٍ أو تُقبل بدونه.

questions.question: What is the core logic of layered defence?
options: If one control fails, the others still stand in the way.
Every control must be identical so none is weakest.
Only the strongest control actually matters.
Each control replaces the one installed before it.
options_ar: لو فشل ضابط واحد، الباقي يظل بالطريق.
كل ضابط لازم يكون مطابقاً حتى ما يكون أضعف.
الضابط الأقوى وحده هو المهم فعلاً.
كل ضابط يستبدل اللي انركّب قبله.
options_en: If one control fails, the others still stand in the way.
Every control must be identical so none is weakest.
Only the strongest control actually matters.
Each control replaces the one installed before it.
questions.explanation: The point is not redundancy for its own sake but the fact that an attacker has to defeat several unrelated things in sequence.
questions.explanation_ar: المقصود مو التكرار لمجرد التكرار، بل إن المهاجم لازم يهزم عدة أشياء غير مترابطة بالتتابع.

questions.question: How is residual risk after several layers expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن الخطر المتبقّي بعد عدة طبقات؟
options: Initial risk plus the sum of one minus each reduction.
Initial risk divided by the product of each reduction.
Initial risk minus the largest single reduction.
Initial risk times the product of one minus each reduction.
options_ar: الخطر الابتدائي زائد مجموع واحد ناقص كل خفض.
الخطر الابتدائي مقسوماً على حاصل ضرب كل خفض.
الخطر الابتدائي ناقص أكبر خفض منفرد.
الخطر الابتدائي مضروباً بحاصل ضرب واحد ناقص كل خفض.
options_en: Initial risk plus the sum of one minus each reduction.
Initial risk divided by the product of each reduction.
Initial risk minus the largest single reduction.
Initial risk times the product of one minus each reduction.
questions.explanation: Each layer keeps only the fraction it does not remove, and those surviving fractions multiply.
questions.explanation_ar: كل طبقة تبقي فقط الكسر اللي ما تزيله، وتلك الكسور الباقية تتضارب.

questions.question: Three layers reduce risk by 40, 50 and 30 percent. What remains?
questions.question_ar: ثلاث طبقات تخفّض الخطر بنسب 40 و 50 و 30 بالمئة. شنو يبقى؟
options: About twelve percent, the product of reductions.
About forty percent, the largest reduction.
About twenty-one percent of the original risk.
About sixty percent, the sum of the reductions.
options_ar: حوالي اثني عشر بالمئة، حاصل ضرب نسب الخفض.
حوالي أربعين بالمئة، أكبر نسبة خفض.
حوالي واحد وعشرين بالمئة من الخطر الأصلي.
حوالي ستين بالمئة، مجموع نسب الخفض.
options_en: About twelve percent, the product of reductions.
About forty percent, the largest reduction.
About twenty-one percent of the original risk.
About sixty percent, the sum of the reductions.
questions.explanation: The remainders are 0.6, 0.5 and 0.7, and multiplying them gives 0.21, so about a fifth survives.
questions.explanation_ar: البقايا هي 0.6 و 0.5 و 0.7، وضربها يعطي 0.21، فما يبقى إلا حوالي الخُمس.

questions.question: Why are the layer contributions multiplied rather than added?
questions.question_ar: ليش مساهمات الطبقات تُضرب بدل ما تُجمع؟
options: Because multiplication is cheaper to compute.
Because each layer acts on what the previous ones left.
Because addition would understate the residual risk.
Because the layers are installed in a fixed order.
options_ar: لأن كل طبقة تشتغل على ما تركته اللي قبلها.
لأن الجمع يقلّل من قيمة الخطر المتبقّي.
options_en: Because multiplication is cheaper to compute.
Because each layer acts on what the previous ones left.
Because addition would understate the residual risk.
Because the layers are installed in a fixed order.
questions.explanation: A layer cannot remove risk that another layer already removed, so its effect applies to the remaining portion only.
questions.explanation_ar: الطبقة ما تقدر تزيل خطراً أزالته طبقة ثانية، فتأثيرها ينطبق على الجزء المتبقّي فقط.

questions.question: What does the multiplicative model require of the layers?
questions.question_ar: شنو يشترط النموذج الضربي من الطبقات؟
options: That they reduce risk independently of one another.
That they all cost roughly the same amount.
That they are installed in the same rack.
That each layer uses the same vendor product.
options_ar: إنها تخفّض الخطر باستقلال عن بعضها.
إن كل طبقة تستخدم نفس منتج المورّد.
options_en: That they reduce risk independently of one another.
That they all cost roughly the same amount.
That they are installed in the same rack.
That each layer uses the same vendor product.
questions.explanation: If one flaw defeats several layers at once, the real residual risk is higher than the formula suggests.
questions.explanation_ar: لو ثغرة واحدة تهزم عدة طبقات دفعة واحدة، فالخطر المتبقّي الحقيقي أعلى من اللي تقوله المعادلة.

questions.question: What does each additional independent layer do to residual risk?
questions.question_ar: شنو تسوي كل طبقة مستقلة إضافية بالخطر المتبقّي؟
options: It subtracts a fixed amount from it.
It leaves it unchanged until a threshold.
It raises it slightly because of complexity.
It multiplies it by another fraction below one.
options_ar: يتركه بلا تغيير لحد عتبة معيّنة.
يضربه بكسر آخر أقل من الواحد.
options_en: It subtracts a fixed amount from it.
It leaves it unchanged until a threshold.
It raises it slightly because of complexity.
It multiplies it by another fraction below one.
questions.explanation: Because the multiplier is always below one, the sequence falls geometrically rather than step by step.
questions.explanation_ar: بما إن المضروب دائماً أقل من واحد، فالمتتالية تنزل هندسياً مو خطوة بخطوة.

questions.question: Does the order of the layers change the arithmetic result?
questions.question_ar: هل ترتيب الطبقات يغيّر النتيجة الحسابية؟
options: Yes, because the perimeter layer always dominates.
Only when the layers are fully independent of each other.
No, multiplication is commutative so the product is the same.
Yes, because later layers are weighted more heavily.
options_ar: فقط إذا كانت الطبقات مستقلة عن بعضها.
options_en: Yes, because the perimeter layer always dominates.
Only when the layers are fully independent of each other.
No, multiplication is commutative so the product is the same.
Yes, because later layers are weighted more heavily.
questions.explanation: Order matters operationally and for cost, but the product of the surviving fractions does not care which came first.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب يهم تشغيلياً وبالكلفة، لكن حاصل ضرب الكسور الباقية ما يهمّه أي واحدة جت أول.

questions.question: Why does the chapter include a user layer at all?
questions.question_ar: ليش الفصل يضمّن طبقة مستخدم أصلاً؟
options: Because it is required by every standard.
Because human behaviour is a control surface too.
Because users physically administer the firewall.
Because it replaces the endpoint layer entirely.
options_ar: لأن سلوك الإنسان سطح ضبط هم.
لأنها تستبدل طبقة الأجهزة الطرفية بالكامل.
options_en: Because it is required by every standard.
Because human behaviour is a control surface too.
Because users physically administer the firewall.
Because it replaces the endpoint layer entirely.
questions.explanation: Policies, awareness and a second factor are controls like any other, and they sit exactly where a stolen credential would otherwise succeed.
questions.explanation_ar: السياسات والتوعية والعامل الثاني ضوابط مثل غيرها، وتجلس بالضبط وين كانت بيانات اعتماد مسروقة ستنجح.

questions.question: What happens to the product if one layer's reduction is close to zero?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير للحاصل لو كان خفض إحدى الطبقات قريباً من الصفر؟
options: Its remainder stays near one, so little is removed.
The other layers compensate fully for it.
The formula becomes invalid and must be reset.
The product falls to zero immediately.
options_ar: تبقى باقيتها قريبة من الواحد، فالقليل يُزال.
المعادلة تصير غير صالحة ولازم تُصفَّر.
options_en: Its remainder stays near one, so little is removed.
The other layers compensate fully for it.
The formula becomes invalid and must be reset.
The product falls to zero immediately.
questions.explanation: A layer that removes almost nothing contributes a remainder near one, and multiplying by one changes nothing.
questions.explanation_ar: طبقة ما تزيل تقريباً شي تساهم ببقية قريبة من واحد، والضرب بواحد ما يغيّر شي.

questions.question: In which layer does a web application firewall sit?
questions.question_ar: بأي طبقة يجلس جدار حماية تطبيقات الويب؟
options: The perimeter layer.
The endpoint layer.
The user layer.
The application layer.
options_en: The perimeter layer.
The endpoint layer.
The user layer.
The application layer.
questions.explanation: It inspects HTTP conversations, so it belongs with secure coding rather than with the network perimeter.
questions.explanation_ar: يفحص محادثات HTTP، فلهذا ينتمي مع البرمجة الآمنة مو مع محيط الشبكة.

questions.question: In which layer does endpoint detection and response sit?
questions.question_ar: بأي طبقة يجلس الكشف والاستجابة الطرفية؟
options: The application layer.
The perimeter layer.
The endpoint layer.
The detection layer only.
options_en: The application layer.
The perimeter layer.
The endpoint layer.
The detection layer only.
questions.explanation: EDR runs on the device and observes process and file behaviour there, which places it in the endpoint layer.
questions.explanation_ar: EDR يشتغل على الجهاز ويراقب سلوك العمليات والملفات هناك، وهذا يضعه بطبقة الأجهزة الطرفية.
